text:
Priya (CS): quick weekly for Opal onboarding — sharing p95/p99 split by route + model and streaming vs non-streaming. TL;DR: one route shows higher streaming p95 this week, but p99s mostly stable. error rate down overall. spend slightly up due to extra test traffic.

Tom (CS Ops): can you paste the numbers? especially for /generate and /chat routes.

Priya (CS): sure — pulled from telemetry this morning. small table below (numbers in ms).
```
Route        | Model                 | Streaming p95 | Streaming p99 | Non-stream p95 | Non-stream p99
/generate    | gpt-open-7b-quant     | 210           | 890           | 170            | 820
/chat        | gpt-open-chat-13b     | 320           | 1200          | 280            | 1150
/embeddings  | embed-lite-2          | n/a           | n/a           | 45             | 120
```
Notes: streaming /generate p95 +24% vs last week (mostly during 11–13 PST test window), p99 +8%. /chat saw slight bump in p99 due to one 6xx on the model pool (investigating).

Jordan (SRE): I pulled the logs — one worker node kicked OOM during the bulk test at 11:12. stack: `gpu-worker-7` hit mem spike when kv-cache grew on long conversation. I restarted pool and evicted old cache entries. Repro steps attached.

Priya (CS): thanks. error rate: 0.6% this week vs 0.9% last week. most errors were 502/503 from that incident window. overall usage: 1.4M tokens/day avg (up 11%); spend this period +8% (billing-bot confirmed), embeddings spike during mapping jobs.

billing-bot: Invoice alert — estimated overage for Opal this period ~$1.8k, threshold 75% usage met.

Evelyn (PM): renewal flag check — Opal is still in trial-to-paid transition. Is the onboarding schedule still green? any blockers that raise churn risk?

Priya (CS): onboarding status: docs + SDK walkthrough done, webhook integration pending (due end of week). main risk is latency tail for streaming on /generate — engineering mitigation planned (see action items). overall NPS feedback: "model quality good, perf inconsistent during test runs".

Tom (CS Ops): action items: 1) Jordan to add a memory cap + graceful eviction on gpu-worker-7 (ETA 24h). 2) Priya to run a focused streaming load with reduced kv retention to reproduce (ETA today). 3) Eng to check model kernel selection for gpt-open-7b-quant for long contexts (EOD).

Jordan (SRE): started config change on canary pool, will monitor metrics and post back.

Priya (CS): coordinating enablement: scheduled a 30m call with Opal engineers Thu 10am PT to walk through best-practices for streaming (cache hints, shorter rollout windows). Sharing a short checklist here: 
- prefer non-stream for long-token heavy jobs where latency predictability matters
- use prefix-caching for repeated prompts
- enable autoscale burst for onboarding tests

Priya (CS): capturing feedback to hand to product: request for a per-route streaming latency SLA and clearer guidance in console about expected tradeoffs.

Evelyn (PM): noted. we should consider a small doc/update in Console -> Best Practices. assign to product backlog if we see more customers ask.

Tom (CS Ops): quick question — is the embeddings increase from their mapping jobs expected to continue next week? Priya?

Priya (CS): Opal plans two more mapping runs next week; forecasted tokens ~+40% over baseline for 48h window (we flagged billing-bot).

Jordan (SRE): monitoring dashboard pinned: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/opal-streaming-latency — will add an annotation for the OOM incident.

Priya (CS): thanks team. summary for execs: Opal onboarding healthy but watch streaming p95 on /generate; mitigation in progress; minor spend overage expected; schedule Thu call for enablement. :white_check_mark:

Tom (CS Ops): :thumbsup:

Evelyn (PM): :raised_hands:

Priya (CS): I'll drop a follow-up thread after the Thu call with updated p95/p99 and any rollout notes.
